wholePhysicalScope: The four mapped vertices bound the named standing ruin, approximately 43.5 by 40.7 metres. Dominant ashlar and subordinate rubble lines are interpreted within that mapped envelope.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the broken ashlar wall and low surviving foundations. Near views refine uneven courses, open joints and displaced blocks.
limitations: The mapped envelope describes the site extent. The precise placement of individual surviving walls, sandstone tones, course heights and trench grade are estimates from two close views.

The geometry depicts the exposed ruin as photographed in 2025. The neighboring Anahita Temple, Mosaic Porch, monumental reliefs and the proposed historical palace volume are outside the modeled extent.
The original elevation field is a composite DEM, which cannot resolve the excavated trench. Some low foundation courses may be obscured when it is viewed with the original field.
